build_cascade_rcnn_roi_heads: build a CascadeROIHeads module with multiple cascade stages for refined object detection box predictions
create_cascade_box_head: create cascade box heads and predictors with configurable IoU thresholds and bbox regression weights per stage
run_cascade_forward_pass: run the CascadeROIHeads forward pass to compute losses during training or predictions during inference
review_match_and_label_boxes: review the _match_and_label_boxes method that matches proposals with ground truth using pairwise IoU at each cascade stage
refactor_scale_gradient: refactor the _ScaleGradient autograd function to scale gradients by 1 over num cascade stages during training
